data.gender_notes: Brahmdev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Brahmdev is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Brahma' (Brahman or the ultimate cosmic power) and 'Dev' (God). The name signifies the supreme deity, the Lord of Brahman. The name Brahmdev carries the meaning “Lord of Brahman” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Brahmdev usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of brahman and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Brahmdev is a powerful name associated with wisdom, knowledge, and the ultimate cosmic power. It is believed to evoke feelings of reverence, respect, and awe.
data.etymology: Brahmdev belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Brahman.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Brahmdev total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

historical_references.reference: Brahmdev is also known as Prajapati, the creator of the universe and the first being in Hindu mythology. He is depicted as having four heads, representing the four Vedas, and four arms, holding the symbols of creation - a rosary (for creation), a sacred thread (for sustenance of creation), a lotus (for creation of the universe), and a pot of nectar (for the nourishment of creation).
